# Telescoping — factor ↔ split ↔ cancel → boundary

Signal: same form + shifted index

$$
A=f(k),\qquad B=f(k+r)
$$

$$
\frac{B-A}{AB}\ \leftrightarrow\ \frac1A-\frac1B
$$

Factor denominator ↔ split fractions; make numerator $=B-A$

$$
+X-X=0,\qquad c\cdot\frac1c=1
$$

Sum: first few + last few → cancel → boundary terms

Example:

$$
(1-\tfrac14)+(\tfrac14-\tfrac19)+\cdots+
\left(\tfrac1{n^2}-\tfrac1{(n+1)^2}\right)
=1-\frac1{(n+1)^2}
$$
